market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as RBA holds rates firm, housing falls accelerate, and US 'higher-for-longer' path weighs on AUD and global risk appetite. Expect volatility around RBA meetings and US data prints. Small-cap miners may outperform on idiosyncratic catalysts.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if housing stabilises and iron ore finds a floor. EV transition and critical-mines demand support structural growth in select ASX names. Dividend-paying energy and healthcare (CSL.AX) remain core holdings. Key risk: prolonged housing downturn triggering broader credit contraction.
